sections.entities: Every row of registry/entities.csv (all 4 levels), in registry order, with registry metadata + the same measured datasets. City dataset payloads here are the SAME objects as under 'cities'.

dataset_status_values.measured: counted from the files on disk
dataset_status_values.source-ceiling: the layer is complete AS PUBLISHED but the source publishes less than a city's (e.g. tally-only minutes -> an empty vote table) — a ceiling, not missing data
dataset_status_values.deferred-by-design: the layer was deliberately not built at this entity's tier — an honest property, not a gap
dataset_status_values.unreadable: the artifact exists but could not be read at build time
